description: Update a webhook's mutable fields (`url`, `active`, `payload_format`, `event_types`, `inbound_inbox_id`). `webhook_type`, `sending_stream`, and `domain_id` cannot be changed after creation.

event_types.description: Events to subscribe to. Applies only to `email_sending` webhooks.

inbound_inbox_id.description: ID of the inbound inbox the webhook is linked to. Applicable only for `inbound_receiving` webhooks.

url.description: New URL that Mailtrap will POST webhook events to.

webhook_id.description: ID of the webhook to update

name: update-webhook
